title: AID Test Portfolio — Quarantine Decision Record
$comment: producer: scripts/aid-quarantine-decision-record.sh (P069 Step 18), ONLY on an explicit PM-provided --decision invocation — never automatic, never inferred from evidence content alone. Retained at .aid-o/work/evidence/quarantine-decisions/<gate_id>-<decided_at>.json, one file per decision (never overwritten — a later, conflicting decision for the SAME gate_id is refused unless it explicitly supersedes the prior one). This record is evidence for a PM/implementer to act on SEPARATELY — no code path in this plan writes to execution.yaml's quarantine: block automatically, even when decision:lift exists here.

gate_id.description: Intentionally single-gate — matches Step 15's own narrowed scope. plan_diff is explicitly out of scope for this whole plan, never decided here.

evidence_ref.description: Path to Step 15's real, schema-valid quarantine-remediation-evidence bundle this decision was based on (.aid-o/work/evidence/quarantine-remediation/bats_all-<commit_sha>.json).

e2e_evidence_ref.description: Path to Step 17's real, schema-valid, pass:true observe_parallel_full_path E2E proof this decision was based on (.aid-o/work/evidence/e2e-full-path-proof/<run_id>.json).

decided_at.$comment: Codex review: format:date-time alone is NOT enforced by this project's validator (jsonschema's date-time format check is a no-op without the optional rfc3339-validator dependency, which is not installed here) — the pattern below is the actual enforcement. Millisecond precision is REQUIRED (not just permitted) so two decisions for the same gate_id within the same wall-clock second never collide on the derived filename (<gate_id>-<decided_at-sanitized>.json).

supersedes.description: The prior record's own decided_at this record explicitly replaces. Absent on a gate's first-ever decision record. Must name the CURRENT unsuperseded leaf record for gate_id (never an already-superseded ancestor) — the producer script enforces this at write time; this schema only constrains shape. The superseded record is never deleted — only this field marks the new one as the current authoritative decision for gate_id.
